hooks.command: P=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$P" in */portfolio/*.md) B=$(basename "$P"); if [ "$B" != "BOARD.md" ] && [ "$B" != "ROADMAP.md" ] && [ "$B" != "BRAGLOG.md" ]; then R="${P%%/portfolio/*}/portfolio"; [ -x "$R/build-views.sh" ] && "$R/build-views.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi ;; esac
